body.definition: every DSO export of each admitted library, with the translation unit that defines it -- measured from the authority's object files -- and the stratum that owns it, taken from symbol-ownership.json. The defining unit is the third fact D163 needed and no artefact carried

inputs.name: authority-build-record
inputs.note: read for the build directory, the profile and the source area; its hash is deliberately not recorded, see this list's comment -- the fields are in body.authority_build

inputs.name: implemented-surface
inputs.note: deliberately **not** read: the module-to-stratum map comes from symbol-ownership.json, which is committed and machine-independent, where I implemented-surface.json carries a build product's hash. Naming it as an input at all would be a claim about a file this generator does not open.

inputs.name: crate-source-tree
inputs.note: every .rs under src/ was read; a module that produces no export still contributes to the module-to-unit map
